lines.zh: 我踏过丛林，翼在身后抖。
lines.en: I stride through the jungle, wings shivering behind.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀很薄，撑得住身体。
lines.en: My wings are thin but hold my weight.

lines.zh: 我一走动，甲片互相擦响。
lines.en: As I move, my plates rasp together.
I go around vines and dodge thorns.
I fly low along the canopy a stretch.

lines.zh: 我朝你有动静的方向去。
lines.en: I head toward the noise you make.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很沉，落在地上。
lines.en: My steps land heavily.

lines.zh: 我走两步就展开翅试探。
lines.en: Every two steps I test my wings.
I emerge slowly from between the trees.
I sniff the air as I go.
My long tail balances behind me.

lines.zh: 我朝更高的地方挪过去。
lines.en: I shift toward higher ground.
I stop in a clearing.
I fold my wings away.
I listen to the insects in the trees.
My head turns a slow full circle.
I shake the plates on my back.

lines.zh: 我的复眼盯着树皮的缝。
lines.en: My compound eyes fix on a crack in the bark.
I lift a claw and test the ground.

lines.zh: 暗处只剩我两只眼睛亮着。
lines.en: Only my two eyes stay bright in the dark.
I draw in my long tail slowly.
I count the nests in the trees.
I stand with great patience.
I sink my claws into the bark.

lines.zh: 我下颌动了动，没发出声。
lines.en: My jaw shifts without a sound.
I wait for my wings to dry.
I am in your jungle.
This face of mine has two sides.
I look down at you, calmly.
You stand there, and I am in no hurry.
My claws are enough to hold you.
The weapon at your waist is decent.
I know this forest.
If you do not move, I will come over.

lines.zh: 我两副面孔一起转向你。
lines.en: Both of my faces turn toward you.
You are panting, and I can count it.
Do not stare at my plates like that.
I sidestep slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 你站在我可以扑到的地方。
lines.en: You stand within my pounce.
I still have wings; you will not escape.

lines.zh: 你身上一股跑过路的汗味。
lines.en: You smell of a long run.

lines.zh: 我一边看你一边张开翅。
lines.en: I spread my wings while watching you.

lines.zh: 我退开，甲片上多了一道。
lines.en: I pull back with a new mark on my plates.
I give a low growl.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的翅膀一沉。
lines.en: That weighed my wing down.
I tuck my wings against my body.
I shake my head and steady.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的推进。
lines.en: That halted my advance.
I step back without falling.

lines.zh: 这一下你砍在了甲缝上。
lines.en: You found the gap between my plates.
I slowly push myself upright.
I retreat a little toward the shade.
A smell of insects; good.

lines.zh: 我长长的舌头先伸出来。
lines.en: My long tongue comes out first.
I lean toward your hand.
Put the insect on the ground.
That meat will do as well.
I smell something sweet.
My neck stretches higher than the branch.
I follow that smell.
Are there insects in your pack?
My tongue sweeps over the teeth at my jaw.
You step back and I step forward.
I wait for you to set it down.

lines.zh: 我们一撞，甲片响成一片。
lines.en: We collide and plates clatter everywhere.
You hit me and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀把你顶到一边。
lines.en: I shoulder you aside.
A wing scrapes the side of your face.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一偏，很快站正。
lines.en: Knocked askew, I straighten at once.
You hit my chest with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 相撞时，树上的叶子落了。
lines.en: At the impact, leaves fall from the trees.
I step back and reset my stance.
We part, and claw marks remain on the ground.

lines.zh: 你踩住尾巴，我往回一抽。
lines.en: You stand on my tail; I snap it back.

lines.zh: 我在这片林子里独自巡。
lines.en: I patrol this jungle alone.

lines.zh: 这种事对我来说太麻烦。
lines.en: That would be too much trouble for me.
I have prey to chase.
I twist my neck slowly around.
You are too close to my claws.
I spread my wings as an answer.
I do not speak of this.
I fly up into the trees a way.
You had better not follow.
I drop back to the same spot.
I dig a claw into it.
I carry it in my jaws, steadily.
I will take this insect.
I press it under a claw.
Too small to fill me.
I pick it up for a look.
I hang it from a claw tip.
I take what hits the ground.
I toss it up into the tree.
I pick it up and drop it again.
You are already my mark.
I square my chest at you.
You are within my hunt range.
I step off toward your side.
You cannot slip out of my sight.
I open my membranes halfway.

lines.zh: 目标就是这个还在走的。
lines.en: The target is the one still moving.
I lower my body, ready to dash.
Your smell is very clear.
I quicken my stride at you.
This time I do not let go.
You are on the list I hunt.
I keep to your rear flank.
You run, and I take to the air.
I walk while keeping my eyes on you.
You look back, and I am among the trees.
I eat up the distance stretch by stretch.

lines.zh: 你收脚，我的爪子也收住。
lines.en: You halt your feet; my claws stop too.
I spread my wings and block the light.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我从上面看。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I watch from above.
Your footsteps are far too obvious.
No hurry; I have wings.
I work slowly around to your front.
The deeper you run, the better.
I dive from above and claw you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓进你的护甲。
lines.en: My claws dig into your armour.

lines.zh: 这一爪带着我整个身子的沉。
lines.en: That claw carried my whole weight.
One claw sweeps across your shoulder.
I knock you flat.
My wing buffets your chest.
That sent you back far.
I bite into your forearm.

lines.zh: 你挡了，可爪子从下面来。
lines.en: You blocked, but a claw came from below.
Not a killing blow.
After striking, I take off again.
Deep claw marks on you now.
A shadow flips down from the canopy.

lines.zh: 甲片一响，我从枝间落下。
lines.en: Armor plates clatter; I drop from the branches.
You hear plates rasping first.

lines.zh: 虫龙兽，从藤蔓里挤出来。
lines.en: Dinobeemon squeezes out of the vines.
When I land, the leaves burst up.

lines.zh: 这一带的虫声忽然停了。
lines.en: The insects here suddenly go quiet.

lines.zh: 我落在你面前，翅还张着。
lines.en: I land before you with wings still spread.

lines.zh: 我从林子的另一边过来。
lines.en: I come from the far side of the wood.
I poke my head from behind a tree.

lines.zh: 我一步步从阴暗里走出来。
lines.en: I walk step by step out of the gloom.
I fold my wings and stand, watching you.

lines.zh: 我一边落地一边嗅空气。
lines.en: I sniff the air as I land.

lines.zh: 火燎到翅膀，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Fire catches a wing and I flinch.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下，砸进灌木。
lines.en: I fall out of the tree into the brush.

lines.zh: 水一闷，我的翅膀动不了。
lines.en: Under water my wings cannot move.
The blast lifts my plates.

lines.zh: 箭扎进翼膜，我偏了一下。
lines.en: An arrow tears my membrane and I bank.
Magic locks my movement.

lines.zh: 很久没吃到虫，我乏力了。
lines.en: Long without insects, and I weaken.
Lightning strikes and I shudder all over.

lines.zh: 虚空扯我，翅膀抓不住空气。
lines.en: The void pulls and my wings find no air.
